Hi, I'm Kae! I'm currently studying a Master of Business Analytics at Monash University as an Australia Awards Mekong–Australia Partnership (AA-MAP) Scholar. Before moving into data analytics, I studied chemistry and polymer science and spent more than six years working across research and development, market development, and product management in the chemical and manufacturing industries.

Working in both technical and business roles sparked my interest in using data to understand problems and make better decisions. I especially enjoy connecting data, business, and science and turning complex information into insights that are easier to understand and use.

Through my Business Analytics studies, I've been building my skills in data analysis, visualisation, statistical modelling, spatial analysis, and databases, using tools such as R, SQL, Power BI, and Excel. I'm particularly interested in how data can be used to explore real-world challenges in areas such as sustainability, energy, and manufacturing.

This blog is a space for me to share what I'm learning and working on, and to explore different ways of turning data into clear and meaningful stories.
